what: per year, fire rows per cell of the fire cube's grid, one scale per family through all its years

grid.col_0: the band from 180 W to 179.75 W

left_out.after_the_archive: every month after 2025-12, the last month of the FIRMS country yearly files: near real time rows from the FIRMS area API, which needs a key, have no type column and are not in the cube
left_out.not_whole: a year not whole at the end of the archive (2026 holds no month of the archive)

modis.what: fire rows (FIRMS type 0, day and night) of Terra and Aqua together

viirs.what: fire rows (FIRMS type 0, day and night) of Suomi NPP alone

modis_on_snpp.what: the modis family's arrays (Terra and Aqua fire rows) drawn on the Suomi NPP scale, so one view can go from MODIS to Suomi NPP and show the step between the instruments in 2012

harmonized.what: the harmonize lane's harmonized fire rows on the Suomi NPP scale
harmonized.state: drawn from the harmonize lane's folder

source.what: harmonized fire rows per cell and year on the fire cube's grid (720 by 1440, north up, row 0 the north band, column 0 at 180 W): MODIS on Suomi NPP's scale, the sum over the year's months of the harmonized dataset's monthly values. NaN where no country file has a row, and in 2021 in the cells that meet a test fire region's context box; 0 in a loaded cell with no fire row of any satellite

method.what: the Record's served method at a quarter degree: a cell's ratio for each month of the year, leaning on its ratio over the year, its eight neighbouring cells and its latitude band, times a factor for the size of the month's MODIS count; before Aqua, Terra alone, fitted the same way

2002.regime: Terra alone to June, Terra and Aqua from July

modis.rule: t = log10(1 + v) / log10(1 + vmax), clipped to 0..1; index = 3 + floor(t * 253), at most 255

suomi_npp.rule: t = log10(1 + v) / log10(1 + vmax), clipped to 0..1; index = 3 + floor(t * 253), at most 255

png.mode: 8 bit indexed with transparency, one pixel per cell, north up

npy: float32 (720, 1440), little endian; NaN where not loaded or closed, 0 where loaded with no fire row
closed_rule: cells meeting a test fire's region's context box, in the years of its fire, hold no value
